# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030), [v3 c14 P37](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0037)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby was a very handsome girl with bright-blue eyes, long golden hair, a brilliant complexion, and a plump figure. During her final illness, she became very thin, her cheeks took on a hectically brilliant color, and her hands grew almost transparently delicate.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004)_

## Personality

Ruby was cheerful, merry, and good-tempered, loving life's pleasantries and laughing frequently. She was intensely focused on boys, romance, compliments, and having a large number of suitors. At times she exhibited a squeamish or fearful nature, particularly regarding play-acting, ghosts, or facing the reality of illness and death.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001), [v1 c28 P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 c11 P7](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0007), [v3 c14 P29](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0029), [v3 c14 P37](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0037)_

## Traits

- Coquettish and fond of male attention  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 c11 P7](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0007)</sub>
- Cheerful and laughter-loving  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v3 c14 P37](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0037)</sub>
- Easily frightened or superstitious about play-acting  <sub>[v1 c28 P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001), [v1 c28 P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013)</sub>

## Abilities

- Needlework and embroidery  <sub>[v3 c14 P33](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0033)</sub>
- Schoolteaching  <sub>[v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006)</sub>

## Goals

- To have numerous suitors and enjoy a very gay youth before settling down  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)</sub>

## History

Ruby grew up in Avonlea as part of the Gillis family. In her youth, she participated in childhood dramatizations with Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Jane Andrews, though she was terrified of pretending to be dead during their play of Elaine. She later attended Queen's Academy, where she was widely considered the handsomest student in her year, and frequently spent her Friday trips home walking with Gilbert Blythe. After earning her license, she taught school at Carmody. Throughout her youth and teaching career, she was noted for her extensive flirtations, receiving romantic attention and proposals from local suitors like Nelson Atkins, Herb Spencer, and Wilbur Blair. During a winter season, she suffered an attack of congestion that led to galloping consumption. Despite her failing health, she remained in denial about her illness and hoped to teach at White Sands in the autumn. She reconnected with Anne Shirley shortly before her passing, expressing a changed perspective on death before dying peacefully in her sleep.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P1](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0001), [v1 c28 P13](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0013), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v1 c35 P6](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0006), [v2 c26 P56](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0056), [v2 c26 P58](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0058), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 c11 P8](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0008), [v3 c14 P24](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0024), [v3 c14 P27](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0027), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in Avonlea with several older sisters  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)</sub>
- Attended Avonlea School and Queen's Academy alongside Anne Shirley and Diana Barry  <sub>[v2 c26 P58](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0058)</sub>
- Taught at a school in Carmody before falling ill  <sub>[v2 c26 P58](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0058), [v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’ll be away Tuesday and Wednesday evenings. There’s a concert at Carmody and a party at White Sands. Herb Spencer’s going to take me. He’s my latest. Be sure to come up tomorrow.
